searchText: With the understanding that MATIC is a side chain and not a layer 2, I’ve read that coinbase does something like this, if I understand you correctly. I haven’t tested it, but apparently I can send coins from matic network directly to coinbase, and they do the bridging on their end when I want to sell, but idk if this is true. If that’s the case though, then it seems like exchanges might be willing to do the same with layer 2’s. > when I want to sell when you transfer funds to coinbase they're no longer your funds, how they manage them is irrelevant and your buying/selling is not related to any chain activity But yes exchanges will want to use L2s and it stands to reason they'll pass on fee savings to users

excerpts.author: treyzania
excerpts.content:
> when I want to sell

when you transfer funds to coinbase they're no longer your funds, how they manage them is irrelevant and your buying/selling is not related to any chain activity

excerpts.author: treyzania
excerpts.content: But yes exchanges will want to use L2s and it stands to reason they'll pass on fee savings to users
